evidence.notes: Search.query executes SOSL FIND with deterministic local fixed search results.
Search.query(String) returns deterministic local SOSL results.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSearchQueryTest { @isTest static void searchQueryReturnsResults() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'SOSL Query Account'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); List<List<SObject>> found = Search.query('FIND {SOSL} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)'); System.assertEquals(1, found.size()); List<SObject> accounts = found[0]; System.assertEquals(1, accounts.size()); System.assertEquals(account.Id, accounts[0].Id); System.assertEquals('SOSL Query Account', ((Account)accounts[0]).Name); } }
